nodes.name: New mail
nodes.notes: Polls the studio inbox every 5 minutes; each message received since the last poll (read or not) runs once. Our own sent mail is excluded by the query.

nodes.name: Ingest
nodes.notes: email_ingest (049) matches the message to a lead, client or project by thread or sender, or stores nothing. One call per message; a failed call does not stop the others.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ job: 'email-inbound', workflow: $workflow.name, status: $json.status, execution_id: String($execution.id), detail: $json.detail }) }}

nodes.name: Hourly
nodes.notes: The Gmail Trigger only runs when mail arrives, so a quiet inbox would read as stale. This hourly probe proves the Gmail credential still works and logs ok; if it fails, the error handler logs the failure.

parameters.jsCode:
// Gmail answered: the credential works. One ok row an hour keeps the health card honest.
return [{ json: { status: 'ok', detail: { heartbeat: true } } }];
